commentary_segments.text: As a result, the prediction of the current and the transconductance cannot be accurate any more. Indeed, in the middle of the square-law region, around V −V =0.2 V, GS T parameter K∞ contains the mobility and factor n, which are not accurate at all indeed. Moreover, for lower values of V −V , we end GS T up too close to weak inversion, complicating the model considerably. On the other side of the V −V range, velocity saturation is moving in closer and closer all GS T the time, requiring another level of complexity. It has now become very difficult to use simple models for hand calculations. The only good chance we have is around V −V #0.2 V for high gain and somewhat more (#0.5 V) for high GS T frequency applications. In all other regions elaborate models have to be used, which are only available from foundries.
